tasks_csv_title_too_long: Title can be at most {max} characters
tasks_csv_bad_date: Write dates as real dates in YYYY-MM-DD
tasks_csv_date_range: Dates must be between the years {min} and {max}
tasks_csv_description_too_long: Description can be at most {max} characters
tasks_csv_tag_too_long: Each tag can be at most {max} characters
tasks_csv_tag_control: A tag contains line breaks, tabs or other control characters
tasks_csv_title_only: "{title}" was created with only its title. Press again to fill in the rest of that task.
tasks_csv_task_gone: "{title}" was deleted or is no longer visible. Press again to create it anew.
tasks_csv_start_after_due: Start date is after the due date
tasks_csv_ambiguous_assignee: More than one person has this name: {name}
tasks_csv_conflict: {title}: changed elsewhere in the meantime. Press again to overwrite it with this line.
tasks_csv_import_error: {reason} ({count} imported; press again to add the rest)

match.countPlural=one: {count} line already imported will be skipped.
match.countPlural=other: {count} lines already imported will be skipped.

match.countPlural=one: {count} task created with only its title will be filled in.
match.countPlural=other: {count} tasks created with only their titles will be filled in.

tasks_csv_resume_restart: To start a new import instead, clear the text first.
tasks_csv_label: One task per line: title, description, status (todo, in_progress, done), priority (none, low, medium, high, urgent), start date, due date (YYYY-MM-DD), estimate (minutes), assignees (names, separated by ;), tags (separated by ;)
tasks_view_conflict: Another tab saved the view "{name}" first, so this save wasn't applied. Your current settings are kept. Pick the view in the list to see the latest settings, or save again to replace them with these.
tasks_board_hint: Drag a card to change its column or order (on touch screens, drag the ⠿ handle). On a card, press Enter to open it, Alt+Left/Right to change its column and Alt+Up/Down to reorder it.
tasks_dialog_description: Edit the task's status, assignees, dates and checklist.
tasks_discard_open_description: If you open another task now, the changes you made here will be lost.
tasks_gantt_empty: No tasks have dates. Add a start or due date in a task's details to see it here as a bar.
tasks_gantt_week_spoken_iso: ISO week {week} of {year} (weeks start on Monday): {from} to {to}
tasks_gantt_week_spoken_range: Week of {from} to {to} (weeks start on Sunday, no week number)
tasks_gantt_links_hint: Depending on the dependency type, lines run from the start or end of a predecessor to the start or end of the task that follows it; the arrow points at the follower. Hover or focus a row name to make its lines bold and describe its dependencies below.

match.countPlural=one: {count} dependency is not drawn because one of its ends cannot be placed on this chart (a task is filtered, undated or outside the shown period, a bar is cut off at the end of the period, or an end is dragged off the chart). Task details list all predecessors and followers.
match.countPlural=other: {count} dependencies are not drawn because one of their ends cannot be placed on this chart (a task is filtered, undated or outside the shown period, a bar is cut off at the end of the period, or an end is dragged off the chart). Task details list all predecessors and followers.

match.countPlural=one: {count} task starting after the first {days} days is in the list view.
match.countPlural=other: {count} tasks starting after the first {days} days are in the list view.

match.countPlural=one: {count} task without dates is in the list view.
match.countPlural=other: {count} tasks without dates are in the list view.

match.countPlural=one: {count} task without dates is in the list and board views.
match.countPlural=other: {count} tasks without dates are in the list and board views.

tasks_not_found: This task doesn't exist or you can't see it.
tasks_conflict: Someone else changed this task in the meantime (now titled “{title}”, status: {status}). Your input is kept.
tasks_clash_heading: Someone else also changed some of these fields
tasks_clash_hint: You and someone else changed the fields below to different values (start date, due date and milestone count as one schedule). Overwriting saves your value in these fields; fields you did not edit keep the latest server values.
tasks_clash_looks_same: These look the same but are stored differently (for example spaces at line ends or invisible characters).
tasks_estimate_invalid: Enter a whole number of minutes (0 or more) for the estimate, or leave it empty.

match.countPlural=one: {count} following task no longer meets its dependency
match.countPlural=other: {count} following tasks no longer meet their dependencies

tasks_shift_retried: The following tasks changed in the meantime, so this was recalculated.
tasks_shift_hint: We suggest moving them later only as far as each dependency (type and lag) needs. Each task keeps its duration.
tasks_shift_blocked_count: {count} following tasks would move, more than the {max} that can move at once, so they can't be saved together. Save without moving them, or cancel.
tasks_shift_blocked_date: The proposed date {date} for {task} is outside the dates that can be saved (1900–2200), so they can't be saved together. Save without moving them, or cancel.
tasks_shift_link_save_all: Save dependency and move following tasks
tasks_shift_undated: Not moved because they have no dates: {tasks}. Set dates to check their dependencies.
tasks_link_meaning_fs: Starts the day after the predecessor finishes.
tasks_link_meaning_ss: Starts no earlier than the day the predecessor starts.
tasks_link_meaning_ff: Finishes no earlier than the day the predecessor finishes.
tasks_link_meaning_sf: Finishes no earlier than the day before the predecessor starts.
tasks_link_lag_hint: Calendar days, 0 or more. Working days are not counted separately.
tasks_link_lag_invalid: Enter a whole number of lag days from 0 to 3650.
tasks_link_changed: This dependency changed elsewhere in the meantime, so nothing was saved. Now: {now}. Save again to apply your values.
tasks_link_gone: This dependency was removed elsewhere in the meantime, so nothing was saved.
tasks_occurrence_note: This is the {date} occurrence of a repeating task. Change the rule on the first occurrence.
tasks_recurrence_needs_date: Save a date first to set up repetition.
tasks_board_hint_unordered: Unless sorted by default order, only the column changes.
tasks_drag_started: Dragging {title}. Drop it where it should go, or press Esc to cancel.
tasks_move_error_network: Couldn't reach the server, so the task wasn't moved. It's back where it was.
tasks_move_error_stale: The task changed elsewhere in the meantime, so it wasn't moved. Showing the latest state.
tasks_move_error_forbidden: You don't have permission to change tasks in this item, so it wasn't moved.
tasks_move_error_gone: The task was deleted or you can no longer see it, so it wasn't moved.
tasks_move_error_archived: The item was archived or changed at the same time, so the task wasn't moved. Try again shortly.
tasks_move_error_other: Couldn't move the task. It's back where it was.
tasks_parent_has_subtasks: A task with subtasks can't go under another task.
tasks_move_slow: {title}: the server is slow to respond. The result isn't known yet.
tasks_move_checking: {title}: checking with the server whether it was saved.
tasks_move_unknown: {title}: couldn't confirm whether it was saved. Check your connection, then check again.
tasks_move_not_saved: {title}: not saved. The card is back where the server has it.
tasks_move_changed: {title}: it changed elsewhere in the meantime, so the latest server state is shown.
tasks_move_busy: {title}: still saving the previous move. Move it again once that finishes.
tasks_move_unordered: {title}: the order within a column cannot change unless sorted by default order. Switch the sort to default order first.
tasks_assignable_load_failed: Couldn't load the people who can be assigned. The current assignees are kept when you save.
tasks_lane_estimate_hint: Column estimates add up the estimated time on the cards (subtask cards are added separately; time actually spent is not included).
tasks_undone_end: {title}: moved back ({status}). The task that was right after it is no longer in that column, so it went to the end.
tasks_undo_changed: {title}: it changed elsewhere after the move, so it wasn't moved back. Showing the latest server state.
tasks_undo_read_failed: {title}: couldn't check the current state, so it wasn't moved back. Check your connection and press it again.
tasks_gantt_edit_hint: Drag a bar to move its dates, or drag either end to change the start or due date. Keyboard: on the task name, Alt+Left/Right moves it a day, Alt+Shift+Left/Right changes the due date by a day (change only the start date in the task details). If later tasks are affected, you're asked before saving. The end of a bar cut off at the end of the shown period cannot be dragged; change its due date with Alt+Shift+Left/Right or in the task details.
tasks_gantt_saved_shifts: {title}: dates changed, and {count} later tasks moved too.
tasks_gantt_changed: {title}: its dates changed elsewhere in the meantime, so it wasn't moved. Showing the latest state.
tasks_gantt_conflict: {title}: the task changed elsewhere in the meantime, so it wasn't saved. Showing the latest state.
tasks_gantt_dialog_description: {from} → {to}. Later tasks that wait for this one are affected.
tasks_move_conflict: {title}: it was moved elsewhere in the meantime, so the retry was not saved and nothing was overwritten. Showing the latest server state.
